title: Hunter Cassidy dials into heartache with emotionally stirring single “Telephone”
htmlContent: Hunter Cassidy’s new single, “Telephone,” captures the deep pain of love that goes unanswered. It’s a heartfelt expression of longing and vulnerability. In “Telephone,” Cassidy talks about the sadness of one-sided love, painting a clear picture of yearning and the silence that often comes with it. Listening feels almost personal, like being a fly on the wall during an intimate moment that never quite takes place. The music is simple and powerful, letting Cassidy’s emotional voice shine. The song feels almost like a short film, where every line carries the burden of things left unsaid. https://open.spotify.com/album/7aAKJhK0ik9wBQYXZWTBfc?si=Na2PP0UOQXWAbnjaZ_I2CA The heartbreaking chorus sticks with you, resembling an unanswered voicemail filled with feelings that are hard to shake off. Cassidy allows you to truly feel the song if you’ve been the one hoping for a call or the one who didn’t reach out, “Telephone” speaks to anyone who has ever waited for a call that never came.
